Nestled within the bustling Lantian Industrial Zone of Yongzhong Town, Longwan District, Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. stands as a dedicated and forward-thinking player in China’s dynamic chemical manufacturing landscape. Strategically positioned in one of Eastern China’s most vital industrial corridors, the company harnesses Wenzhou’s robust logistics infrastructure—including proximity to Wenzhou Port and major expressways—to ensure efficient domestic distribution and seamless global export capabilities.  

Specializing in the research, development, and production of high-performance chemical solutions, Longchang Chemical serves diverse sectors such as textiles, plastics, agriculture, construction, and industrial manufacturing. Its product portfolio emphasizes quality, consistency, and evolving market demands, with a growing focus on sustainable formulations and eco-conscious production methodologies. The company operates under rigorous international quality and environmental management frameworks, prioritizing workplace safety, regulatory compliance, and responsible resource management in alignment with national green development initiatives.  

Supported by modern production facilities, a committed technical team, and a customer-centric ethos, Longchang Chemical cultivates enduring partnerships through responsive service, technical expertise, and tailored solutions. Deeply rooted in the economic fabric of Longwan District—a hub renowned for innovation and industrial excellence—the company actively contributes to regional growth while advancing its vision of technological progress and environmental stewardship. As it continues to expand its capabilities and global footprint, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. remains steadfast in its mission: delivering reliable chemical solutions that empower industries and support a cleaner, more sustainable future.
